thesis: Confirmed FY Q4 2026 results showed GMV of $14.1 billion (+36% year over year), revenue of $1.166 billion (+33%), and GAAP operating income of $147 million. Although the quarter's $1.617 billion GAAP net income was largely boosted by a $1.448 billion tax benefit, the operating-income gain and fiscal Q1 2027 GAAP operating-margin outlook of 11.5%–13.5% support a constructive underlying read.
invalidation: Fiscal Q1 2027 operating margin falls below guidance or GMV and revenue growth decelerate materially without offsetting credit-quality improvement.

thesis: Confirmed Q2 2026 results showed revenue of $268.5 million (+8.6% year over year), a 4.6% GAAP operating margin versus a prior-year loss, and a raised full-year outlook. The modest top-line growth rate is the strongest counter-evidence, but the move to positive GAAP operating income and higher full-year guidance support a constructive company-specific read.
invalidation: Full-year guidance is reduced or GAAP operating income reverses while revenue growth remains in the single digits.

thesis: The Q2 2026 evidence is mixed: GTV increased 6.3% and GAAP net income increased 100.8% as operating margin rose to 12.3%, but net revenue fell 5.7% and much of the improvement came from cost optimization. The GTV and profitability gains suggest operating resilience, yet the revenue contraction keeps the long read low-conviction.
invalidation: GTV turns negative or revenue contraction persists while operating-margin improvement fades.

thesis: Confirmed Q2 FY2027 results showed subscription ARR growth of 33%, revenue growth of 38%, positive operating cash flow, and raised full-year guidance. Those operating gains support a long read, but a former employee was indicted in a government-contract matter and Rubrik disclosed an ongoing related DOJ and internal investigation, creating a governance-history risk that keeps conviction low.
invalidation: Subscription ARR growth slows materially, full-year guidance is reduced, or the DOJ matter expands into charges or sanctions against Rubrik.
sources: Rubrik statement on former-employee DOJ indictment: https://www.rubrik.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/24/rubriks-statement-on-former-employee-doj-indictment

thesis: Confirmed Q1 FY2027 results showed revenue growth of 15%, cRPO growth of 21%, operating cash flow of $132 million, and adjusted free cash flow of $143 million; fiscal-year guidance calls for positive GAAP operating margin. The current-quarter $24 million GAAP operating loss is the strongest counter-evidence, but the contracted-revenue growth, cash generation, and positive-margin outlook support a constructive read.
invalidation: cRPO growth falls materially, fiscal-year guidance is reduced, or the company no longer expects positive GAAP operating margin.
